approach: Static recompilation with the RT64 renderer; game screens redrawn natively with RmlUi
notes: Full English and Chinese translations alongside the original Japanese, switchable in game. Widescreen 4:3 to 16:9 without stretching. Modern dialogue reader (history, auto-play, fast-forward, skip), redesigned pre-battle screen, stoppable battle animations, 2x speed, extra save slots and autosaves, remappable controls, RetroArch filters and bezels, a Library and a Battle Viewer. Original bug fixes with individual toggles. Optional HD art pack for portraits, battles, backgrounds, maps and icons.
